## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes (and `make install-test` if you changed the installer)
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits, such as `fix(agent): ...`
- [ ] Code, comments, messages and docs are in English
- [ ] The agent's own packages still do not import `os/exec`
- [ ] Tests cover the change
